head: Bare is a shopping list that sorts items by store aisle
dek: Bare is a simple shopping list: type an item and it goes into the right store section, like Produce or Dairy, so the list follows your way through the store. It was #22 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: It has no accounts, settings, ads, recipes or prices. It's made by Sindre Sorhus and costs $2 once, with no in-app purchases.
where: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac, App Store, $2
means: If shopping apps feel too busy, this one only does the list.
todo: Find Bare in the App Store.
